environment.description: NestJS microservice running in a Docker container on ECS Fargate with default security context. Container runs as root (UID 0). No MAC policy applied. The container filesystem is writable and the process has full access to /etc, /var, /tmp, and all mounted volumes. Node.js v18 runtime with no --frozen-intrinsics flag.

config.security_context: default (no seccomp, no AppArmor, no SELinux)
config.network: internal VPC, port 3000 exposed to ALB
